input.query: SELECT signup_month, SUM(n_signups) signups, SUM(n_email_verified) email_verified, SUM(n_kyc_started) kyc_started, SUM(n_doc_submitted) doc_submitted, SUM(n_kyc_approved) kyc_approved, SUM(n_first_topup) topup, SUM(n_activated) activated, SUM(n_email_verified)::DOUBLE/SUM(n_signups) email_rate, SUM(n_kyc_started)::DOUBLE/SUM(n_email_verified) kyc_start_rate, SUM(n_doc_submitted)::DOUBLE/SUM(n_kyc_started) doc_rate, SUM(n_kyc_approved)::DOUBLE/SUM(n_doc_submitted) approval_rate, SUM(n_first_topup)::DOUBLE/SUM(n_kyc_approved) topup_rate, SUM(n_activated)::DOUBLE/SUM(n_first_topup) activation_after_topup FROM agg_funnel_monthly WHERE channel='organic' AND signup_month IN (DATE '2026-03-01',DATE '2026-04-01') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
